chapters.name: Life Science
chapters.summary: Cells, the human body, nutrition, genetics, and ecology.
keyPoints: Mitochondria release energy for the cell.
Red blood cells carry oxygen.

chapters.name: Physical Science
chapters.summary: Matter, chemistry basics, energy, forces, heat, light, and sound.
keyPoints: An atom's nucleus holds protons and neutrons.
Sound needs a medium; it cannot travel through a vacuum.

chapters.name: Earth and Space Science
chapters.summary: Rocks, weather, the atmosphere, and the solar system.
keyPoints: Igneous rock forms from cooled magma or lava.
Earth's tilt causes the seasons.

chapters.name: Arithmetic Word Problems
chapters.summary: Word problems with rates, percents, ratios, averages, time, money, and simple interest.
keyPoints: Distance = rate x time.
Average = total / number of items.

chapters.name: Vocabulary
chapters.summary: Choosing the word closest in meaning, alone or in a sentence.
keyPoints: Use the sentence to guess the meaning.
Learn common roots, prefixes, and suffixes.

chapters.name: Reading Short Passages
chapters.summary: Finding the main idea, stated details, word meaning in context, and sound conclusions from a short passage.
keyPoints: Answer from the passage, not from outside knowledge.
The main idea covers the whole passage, not one detail.

chapters.name: Numbers and Algebra
chapters.summary: Number properties, exponents, roots, equations, inequalities, and factoring.
keyPoints: Do the same thing to both sides of an equation.
A negative number times a negative number is positive.

chapters.name: Geometry
chapters.summary: Angles, triangles, area, perimeter, volume, and circles.
keyPoints: The angles of a triangle add up to 180 degrees.
Area of a circle = pi x r squared.

chapters.name: Electricity and Circuits
chapters.summary: Current, voltage, resistance, Ohm's law, series and parallel circuits, and common parts.
keyPoints: Ohm's law: V = I x R.
Power: P = V x I.

chapters.name: Automotive Systems
chapters.summary: Engines, fuel, cooling, brakes, steering, suspension, and electrical systems of cars and trucks.
keyPoints: A four-stroke engine cycle: intake, compression, power, exhaust.
The radiator removes engine heat through the coolant.

chapters.name: Shop Tools and Practices
chapters.summary: Hand and power tools, fasteners, measuring tools, and materials.
keyPoints: A torque wrench tightens a bolt to a set tightness.
A miter box guides a saw for angle cuts.

chapters.name: Mechanical Principles
chapters.summary: Levers, pulleys, gears, inclined planes, pressure, and basic forces.
keyPoints: Effort x effort arm = load x load arm.
Two meshed gears turn in opposite directions.
